opening.argument: The material is a finance-conference interview focused on how firms can put AI to work, not a solicitation. Its description frames the discussion as an investigation into implementing AI projects in financial services. The speaker moves from explaining what technologies such as blockchain and natural language processing can realistically do to the organizational work involved, including bringing compliance, legal, IT, and business teams together early. That is consistent with a professional discussion of AI adoption and business transformation. Nothing in the described material asks viewers to invest, pay, provide credentials, or join a money-making scheme; the evidence supports an educational and operational purpose, not a financial offer.

citations.quote: To investigate how financial services firms can move beyond the hype of AI and start implementing and delivering successful AI projects
It's not Bitcoin, it's a technology and so on. What natural language processing really means, what you can really expect from that.
Then it's also finding the right partners, internally and externally, onboard people like compliance, legal from the very first day together with the IT and the business
